what: P13e bake arms: one 210 s profiled lobby run each (perf-device.py --profile --seconds 210 --extra switchArm=<arm>), about 3 course switches per arm. Read from the glInventory and sceneryBakePasses log lines (tools/perf-p13e-arms.py).

criteria.i: no interval over 100 ms in any switch window (k=1..19)
criteria.ii: every bake frame at or under 50 ms of work: ii_maxSliceMs is the bake's own ms per pass; ii_maxPassFrameWorkMs the whole frame's work over the window frames that ran a pass (with no pass in the switch frame, k=0 is excluded; otherwise k=0 also carries the switch itself, 28-85 ms)
criteria.iv: lowest max frame among the arms that pass

limits: Switch windows are 20 frames; a bake runs 50-130 passes, so frames past k=19 are graded only in the two graded runs. The arm runs are not host-settled. The first course (scrap-1-c) bakes at startup, outside every window.

arms.what: The bake before P13e (one ground draw in the switch frame, 3 ms slices). Reproduces P13d.
At most 9 passes (budget 40 ms, the 9th runs the rest).
glFinish at the end of every slice (diagnostic).
Ground quad through 8 scissored row bands, one per pass; no sync.
ground8 with glFinish at the end of every slice (diagnostic).
8 bands, glFinish on each band pass, no pass in the switch frame.
16 bands, glFinish on each band pass, no pass in the switch frame. Shipped (BakeShape.SHIPPED).
bands8 with glFlush instead of glFinish.
